James — order made today. Headlines: multi-track, Model D extended disclosure by 11 July; witness statements by 12 Sept; one metallurgy expert each, reports by 31 Oct, joint statement by 28 Nov; ADR to be considered by 30 Sept; 5-day trial window from 9 Feb 2026. Costs of CMC in the case. I'll diarise everything.

Tom

messages.subject: Project update — directions and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Grace,

The court has set the timetable to trial (5-day window from 9 February 2026). The immediate priorities are: (1) disclosure by 11 July — we'll need your production, purchasing and finance records; (2) instructing our metallurgist; and (3) finalising Henry's witness statement. The court has also directed the parties to consider mediation by 30 September, which we'd recommend given the clause 11 uncertainty on both sides.

We'll send a disclosure questionnaire this week.

Best,
James

--
